integrity: Mathematical proof is self-contained modulo the displayed, differentiated standard dilogarithm functional equation; finite checks support but do not replace the proof. The antecedent integer sequence predates its 2022 study.
limitations: Exact valuations are proved only for integers \(u\ge3\) at indices \(n=2^{2^u+u}-2^u-1\); no claim for other indices or independent external certification. Classical logarithm and dilogarithm vanishing identities are used as established tools.
title: Third-order dyadic cancellation in Farhi's integer sequence
